findings.reason: Mutex is sound (inFlight never rejects, release() in finally, FIFO keeps takeToolUseId pairing). Gap: a call queued behind a banka does not re-check after `await previous` whether the parent turn is still alive; if the parent is stopped/timed out while call 2 waits, runOne founds a new chat_thread row and runs an orphan child turn (no transagent brackets, no cascade). Only reachable if the SDK dispatches two runTransagent tool_uses concurrently (the defensive branch). Fix: after `await previous`, refuse ABORTED (founding nothing) when the parent's adapter is gone/aborted, or drop queued waiters when the parent turn ends.

Serialization tests cover only the happy path: add a case where the in-flight child's runTurn rejects (AGENT_ERROR/ABORTED) and assert the next queued call still founds its row and returns; and a refused call (patch without patchPath) does not block a queued one.

Comment at the dispatcher construction still says it 'is itself stateless (two injected fields)'; it now carries per-turn state (inFlight) and must stay turn-scoped and shared across executes — update the comment.
